notes: Heartbeat is wake/reference only and grants no execution or release authority.
WorkerCoordinator must bind a fresh authorized claim/fence before invoking this adapter.
The adapter invokes the generalized TVC aggregate-release executor through task-bound instance catalog entries; no ODA3-specific executor exists.
GITHUB_TOKEN, GH_TOKEN and provider API keys are rejected by the worker.
Only TVC_EPHEMERAL_GITHUB_TOKEN may be inherited by the TVC child process, and its value is never logged or returned.
GitHub Actions remains validation-only and is not a release/runtime authority.
